 Kyrie Irving's interest in joining East powerhouse revealed 
 2026-10-30 09:15 
 Dallas Mavericks star Kyrie Irving is reportedly interested in playing for the Miami Heat.
 Credit: AP-Scanpix 
 Credit AP-Scanpix 
 Credit AP-Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 Since the offseason, trade rumors surrounding the Dallas Mavericks star Kyrie Irving have linked him to a potential move to the Miami Heat , and he is reportedly interested in continuing his career in South Beach.

 "I think we've both heard he's interested in playing down in Miami," NBA reporter Ethan J. Skolnick said on the Five on the Floor podcast .
 "I also know Spoelstra holds him in very high regard. — All indications are this is a place he'd be comfortable. My thought is, I don't think anything is imminent. I think the Heat are going to let this play out a little bit and see if Larsson can make the leap," he added.
 Heat might not have enough assets to execute potential deal
 Shams Charania of ESPN earlier raised doubts about the Heat's chances of acquiring Irving due to their lack of available assets to convince the Dallas Mavericks.
 "I'm sure, knowing the Heat, they're going to be monitoring Kyrie Irving, but there's going to be several teams eyeing Kyrie Irving. The question is, if you're Miami, what can you give for Kyrie Irving? You already traded away three first-round picks and a swap and other assets to go get Giannis Antetokounmpo to bring to this team," Charania said on The Pat McAfee Show. "So, what can you trade?
 "Right now, I believe they have one first-round pick eligible to be traded. Is that enough to get Kyrie Irving? My sense is probably not. I think the price would be higher than that."
 The Heat find themselves off to a rough and disappointing start, beginning their 2026-27 NBA season with a 1-4 record.
 After an offseason filled with hype and expectations upon landing Giannis Antetokounmpo, the Heat are suddenly struggling on both ends of the court.
 It will be intriguing to see how the Heat continue to monitor Kyrie Irving, especially if their slump continues. However, they truly lack the assets to offer after the blockbuster deal for Antetokounmpo.
 Additionally, the Dallas Mavericks have not shown any interest in trading Irving away, as the star point guard is finally playing after missing the entire 2025-26 season due to a torn ACL.
 So far, Irving is averaging 18 points, 3.8 assists, 3.3 rebounds, and 1.5 steals while shooting 49.1% from the field.
